tool_args.rationale: Prior confirmation rules out the specific fitted ODE and siphon forms, but observations and pilot signatures still suggest smooth transient lag. A two-mode exponential response is a compact alternative that separates relaxing initial-state and memory contributions from the input-driven response; fitting all available training rows can test it against fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The only available batch was already purchased; the repeated purchase attempt confirmed it cannot add rows.
Its prior fresh confirmation RMSE of 0.080412 exceeded the 0.045 tolerance.
The barrier model and square-root siphon branch were both refuted by fresh confirmation, with materially worse error.
No high-frequency chaotic-sign signature or evidence refuting all stationary smooth mechanisms is present; the temporal-lag signature still motivates a revised smooth transient model.
